LanguageData.RM_WatcherStalk_Setting_Enabled_Tip: The watcher raises a camera on a stalk out of the deck seams, turns it to follow you, and pulls it down when you come near. Off: it is a small machine that crawls the seams and never looks up.
LanguageData.RM_WatcherStalk_Setting_Animation_Tip: The stalk grows up out of the seam and pulls back into it. Off: it is simply up or down.
LanguageData.RM_WatcherStalk_Setting_Smooth_Tip: The camera head turns round a few degrees at a time to follow you. Off: it snaps to the nearest of its eight directions.
